# LFP Mainstream Value Resilience

- Document Class: Hypothesis
- Status: Active
- Date: 2026-05-10
- Category: EV residual value
- Scope: Whether LFP-equipped EVs may hold mainstream value well.
- Sources: `raw/research/2026-05-10-ev-battery-technologies/sources/01-lfp-lmfp-phosphate-lithium-ion.md`
- Related: `wiki/references/lfp-lmfp-phosphate-lithium-ion.reference.md`

## Hypothesis

LFP-equipped EVs may retain practical used-market value well in mainstream segments because buyers can value low replacement risk, long cycle life, low cost, and simpler charging behavior more than maximum range.

## Rationale

LFP's lower cost and durability make it attractive for standard-range vehicles. Its ability to tolerate routine 100% charging can make the usable daily range closer to the nominal range than in vehicles where owners routinely limit charge to 80%.

## Key Risk

LFP vehicles may be discounted in cold climates, long-range use cases, towing, and premium segments where energy density and winter performance matter more.
